name: Iron Jugulis
description: Iron Jugulis, the Paradox Pokémon. A Dark and Flying type.
pokedex_entries: It resembles a certain Pokémon introduced in a paranormal magazine, described as the offspring of a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.
It's possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.
